title: Coiled Dragon Spirit
description: A small green dragon with orange eyes and a purple lightning bolt on its chest is curled inside a swirling, serpentine loop of its own vine-covered body. The dragon has leafy textures, small wings, and is surrounded by floating green leaves and golden particles against a dark swirling background.
prompt: A small green dragon with orange eyes curled inside a large swirling loop formed by its own long serpentine body covered in green leaves and purple accents, glowing purple lightning bolt on chest, small wings, floating leaves and golden particles, set against a dark swirling cosmic background in a painterly fantasy style
